title: Autophagy-lysosomal related protein, TFEB, may serve as a biomarker of mechanical asphyxia: A primary study.
authors: Zhang, Weigang; Shi, Yi; Chen, Yue; Wu, Tianpu; Zhang, Zhenghui; Xu, Hongmei; Jiang, Hanfeng; Wang, Qi; Shao, Yu; Zhang, Weiyi; Li, Wencan; Tian, Lu; Zhang, Dongchuan; Xiao, Bi; Ma, Kaijun; Liao, Xinbiao; Yan, Yifeng; Wang, Lin; Chen, Long
one_liner_zh: 该研究将TFEB作为机械性窒息法医诊断生物标志物，虽涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是细胞与组织表达验证，非TF-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The postmortem diagnosis of death from mechanical asphyxia (DMA) remains challenging owing to the absence of specific morphological signs. The present study evaluated the potential of transcription factor EB (TFEB), a master regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway (ALP), as a biomarker for MA. Through transcriptomic analysis, molecular docking, molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and an SH-SY5Y cell hypoxia model, we observed that TFEB expression was upregulated and nuclear translocation was induced during the initial phase of hypoxia. Following prolonged hypoxia (24 h), however, autophagy flux arrest and lysosomal dysfunction were observed. Mechanistically, we found that tomatidine (TA) could ameliorate these dysfunctions by activating the AMPK-TFEB signalling axis. In human brain tissue samples collected during the early postmortem interval (PMI), the MA group exhibited significantly increased TFEB and LC3 expression and decreased LAMP1 expression. ROC curve analysis demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy of TFEB for MA (AUC = 0.8526). Collectively, these findings identify TFEB and ALP-associated proteins as potential molecular markers for the postmortem diagnosis of MA.
abstract_zh: 机械性窒息（DMA）致死的死后诊断因缺乏特异性形态学标志而仍具挑战性。本研究评估了转录因子EB（TFEB）——自噬-溶酶体通路（ALP）的主要调控因子——作为机械性窒息（MA）生物标志物的潜力。通过转录组分析、分子对接、分子动力学（MD）模拟及SH-SY5Y细胞缺氧模型，我们观察到在缺氧初期TFEB表达上调并诱导核转位。然而，在长时间缺氧（24小时）后，观察到自噬流阻滞和溶酶体功能障碍。机制上，我们发现番茄碱（TA）可通过激活AMPK-TFEB信号轴改善这些功能障碍。在死后早期间隔（PMI）收集的人脑组织样本中，MA组表现出TFEB和LC3表达显著增加，而LAMP1表达降低。ROC曲线分析显示TFEB对MA具有较高的诊断准确性（AUC = 0.8526）。综上，这些发现将TFEB及ALP相关蛋白确定为MA死后诊断的潜在分子标志物。
